notes.title: Version 1,1 Released
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 with some hot fixes.
[list]
[*]Added Auto aim (Auto Pilot) which can be toggled. Please note that some mechs do not have this feature (Milena, Praetorian, and RunnerRX)
[*]Fixed Upgrade panel getting stuck if ESC key is pressed just as it opens

[*]Fixed Evolution UI text size fitting

[/list]

notes.title: Project Lazarus 2 Released!
notes.notes:
Finally Project Lazarus 2 is out. 
My goal was to continue from where Project Lazarus 1 left off. The base goal was to have as much content as the original Project Lazarus 1. And with legacy content being available, it should be a while until we run out of stuff to blow up :)

So some content was cut from the release for various reasons, mostly being the content not being completely ready. I will be adding back content over the next few weeks!

I also found some bugs, so I will be releasing a small fix soon.
If you come across bugs, kindly leave a post in our forum under the Bug Report section.

Thank you and hope you have fun playing PL2!
